verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device inference SDK/CLI. Controlling context memory allocation across concurrent model instances is a fair performance axis for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents context-size settings, KV-cache or memory budgets, or running multiple model instances concurrently. The hardware-acceleration and NPU items cover other features and say nothing about memory allocation.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can control how context memory is allocated when running multiple model instances concurrently
